name: access_keys
sql:
CREATE TABLE access_keys (
	    id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 32 AND id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
	    name         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(CAST(name AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
	    token_hash   BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(token_hash) = 32),
	    permissions  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (permissions IN (1,2,3,7)),
	    created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at >= 0),
	    expires_at   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (expires_at = 0 OR expires_at > created_at),
	    revoked_at   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revoked_at >= 0)
	) STRICT

name: dedup
sql:
CREATE TABLE dedup (
	    queue        TEXT NOT NULL,
	    message_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
	    request_hash TEXT,
	    seq_number   INTEGER NOT NULL,
	    seen_at      INTEGER NOT NULL,
	    PRIMARY KEY (queue, message_id)
	) STRICT

name: idx_access_keys_created
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_access_keys_created ON access_keys(created_at DESC, id DESC)

name: idx_dedup_seen
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_dedup_seen ON dedup(seen_at)

name: idx_msg_active
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_msg_active ON messages(queue, id) WHERE state='active'

name: idx_msg_completed
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_msg_completed ON messages(queue, id) WHERE state='completed'

name: idx_msg_deferred
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_msg_deferred  ON messages(queue, id)            WHERE state='deferred'

name: idx_msg_dlq
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_msg_dlq       ON messages(queue, id)            WHERE state='dead_lettered'

name: idx_msg_expire
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_msg_expire    ON messages(expires_at)           WHERE expires_at>0

name: idx_msg_group_inflight
sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_msg_group_inflight ON messages(queue, group_id, state, locked_until)
	  WHERE group_id IS NOT NULL

name: idx_msg_locked
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_msg_locked    ON messages(state, locked_until)  WHERE state='locked'

name: idx_msg_locked_head
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_msg_locked_head ON messages(queue, id) WHERE state='locked'

name: idx_msg_sched_head
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_msg_sched_head  ON messages(queue, id) WHERE state='scheduled'

name: idx_msg_scheduled
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_msg_scheduled ON messages(state, visible_at)    WHERE state='scheduled'

name: idx_queue_deleting
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_queue_deleting ON queues(delete_started_at, name) WHERE lifecycle_state='deleting'

name: idx_recv_attempt_expire
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_recv_attempt_expire ON receive_attempts(expires_at)

name: idx_settlement_expire
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_settlement_expire ON settlement_receipts(expires_at)

name: idx_subs_by_subscription
sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_subs_by_subscription ON subscriptions(subscription)

name: idx_subs_by_topic
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_subs_by_topic ON subscriptions(topic)

name: idx_subscription_expiry
sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_subscription_expiry ON queues(expires_at, name)
	  WHERE kind='subscription' AND lifecycle_state='active' AND expires_at>0

name: messages
sql:
CREATE TABLE messages (
	    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
	    queue          TEXT NOT NULL,
	    state          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
	                       CHECK (state IN ('active','locked','deferred','scheduled','completed','dead_lettered')),
	    visible_at     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	    locked_until   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	    lock_token     TEXT,
	    delivery_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	    enqueued_at    INTEGER NOT NULL,
	    expires_at     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	    message_id     TEXT,
	    correlation_id TEXT,
	    reply_to       TEXT,
	    group_id       TEXT,
	    content_type   TEXT,
	    subject        TEXT,
	    properties     TEXT,
	    body           BLOB NOT NULL,
	    dead_letter_reason      TEXT,
	    dead_letter_description TEXT
	) STRICT

name: meta
sql: CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

name: queues
sql:
CREATE TABLE queues (
	    name                  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
	    kind                  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queue' CHECK (kind IN ('queue','subscription')),
	    lock_duration_ms      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30000,
	    max_delivery_count    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
	    default_ttl_ms        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	    dead_letter_on_expire INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
	    dedup_window_ms       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	    ordering_mode         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standard'
	                              CHECK (ordering_mode IN ('standard','group_fifo','strict_fifo')),
	    -- per-queue DLQ retention overrides (MQLITE-29). 0 = inherit the broker/engine
	    -- default; >0 = this queue's own bound; -1 = explicitly unbounded (opt out of
	    -- the default). Enforced drop-oldest by reapDLQ.
	    dlq_max_age_ms        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	    dlq_max_count         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	    dlq_max_bytes         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	    lifecycle_state       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (lifecycle_state IN ('active','deleting')),
	    delete_started_at     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	    -- Subscription lifetime is fixed when the mapping is first created. Plain
	    -- queues never expire; zero keeps a subscription permanent.
	    expires_at            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (
	                              expires_at=0 OR (kind='subscription' AND expires_at>created_at)),
	    created_at            INTEGER NOT NULL,
	    updated_at            INTEGER NOT NULL
	) STRICT

name: receive_attempts
sql:
CREATE TABLE receive_attempts (
	    queue       TEXT NOT NULL,
	    attempt_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
	    response    TEXT NOT NULL,
	    created_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,
	    expires_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,
	    PRIMARY KEY (queue, attempt_id)
	) STRICT

name: settlement_receipts
sql:
CREATE TABLE settlement_receipts (
	    lock_token  TEXT NOT NULL,
	    queue       TEXT NOT NULL,
	    seq_number  INTEGER NOT NULL,
	    operation   TEXT NOT NULL,
	    args        TEXT NOT NULL,
	    created_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,
	    expires_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,
	    PRIMARY KEY (queue, seq_number, lock_token, operation, args)
	) STRICT

name: subscriptions
sql:
CREATE TABLE subscriptions (
	    topic        TEXT NOT NULL,
	    subscription TEXT NOT NULL,
	    filter_json  TEXT,
	    created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
	    PRIMARY KEY (topic, subscription),
	    FOREIGN KEY (subscription) REFERENCES queues(name) ON DELETE CASCADE
	) STRICT

name: trg_messages_queue_update
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_messages_queue_update
	 BEFORE UPDATE OF queue ON messages
	 WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM queues WHERE name=NEW.queue)
	 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'FOREIGN KEY constraint failed'); END

name: trg_queues_messages_delete
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_queues_messages_delete
 BEFORE DELETE ON queues
 WHEN NOT (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages WHERE queue=OLD.name AND state='active') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages WHERE queue=OLD.name AND state='locked') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages WHERE queue=OLD.name AND state='deferred') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages WHERE queue=OLD.name AND state='scheduled') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages WHERE queue=OLD.name AND state='completed') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages WHERE queue=OLD.name AND state='dead_lettered'))
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'FOREIGN KEY constraint failed'); END

name: trg_queues_messages_rename
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_queues_messages_rename
 BEFORE UPDATE OF name ON queues
 WHEN NEW.name<>OLD.name AND NOT (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages WHERE queue=OLD.name AND state='active') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages WHERE queue=OLD.name AND state='locked') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages WHERE queue=OLD.name AND state='deferred') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages WHERE queue=OLD.name AND state='scheduled') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages WHERE queue=OLD.name AND state='completed') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages WHERE queue=OLD.name AND state='dead_lettered'))
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'FOREIGN KEY constraint failed'); END
